summary: Iteration 48 — Validated NEW Admin Proofs review actions + CSV export end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_admin_proofs.py with 11 new pytest cases (3 modules: TestProofActionValidation, TestProofActionStamping, TestProofsCsvExport). Final result: 23/23 PASS in 5.24s. Validation coverage: invalid ptype→404 'Tipo de comprobante invalido', unknown id→404 'Comprobante no encontrado', invalid action→400 'Accion invalida', reject without note→400 'Motivo requerido para rechazar', no token→401/403. Stamping coverage: action=reviewed stamps admin_reviewed_at/by/by_name + admin_review_action='reviewed' WITHOUT changing status (verified status==prev_status post-action), action=reject sets status='rejected' and stamps audit, action=approve sets status='approved' and stamps audit. Listing endpoint enrichment confirmed (admin_review_action/by_name/note/reviewed_at echoed back in subsequent GET /api/admin/proofs). CSV export: 401/403 without token, 200 + Content-Disposition attachment + text/csv content-type with required header row 'fecha,tipo,usuario,email,monto,moneda,referencia,estado,tiene_archivo,id,revisado_por,accion_revision,fecha_revision,nota_revision' and filter type=crypto produces exactly len(crypto_items) data rows all tagged 'Pago Crypto'. Frontend Playwright E2E (admin login → /admin/proofs): proofs-export-csv-btn renders 'Exportar CSV (3)', clicking triggers real browser download with header line matching backend contract. Modal opens via proof card click → proof-action-panel renders all 3 buttons (reviewed/approve/reject), textarea, and disclaimer 'El crédito de saldo se gestiona desde la cola dedicada'. Reject WITHOUT note flow: textarea gets visual rose ring (border-rose-500/60 ring-1 ring-rose-500/40), modal stays open, toast 'Motivo requerido'. Reject WITH note flow: modal closes, toast 'Rechazado' appears, listing refreshes and card now shows 'rejected' status pill plus ShieldCheck reviewed badge with 'reject · Admin LIONSBIT'. Mark-reviewed flow: closes modal, toast 'Marcado como revisado', card decorated with 'reviewed · Admin LIONSBIT' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/admin.py admin_proofs_export_csv() reuses admin_list_proofs() then performs a SECOND set of per-type queries to hydrate admin_reviewed_* fields, but admin_list_proofs() already enriches every item with those exact fields. Drop the second query loop — saves 4 round-trips per export and simplifies code (use i.get('admin_reviewed_by_name') etc directly).

AdminProofAction.note has no max length; backend accepts arbitrarily long strings while frontend caps at 300 chars. Add a max_length=500 validator on the Pydantic model to mirror the UI limit and prevent abuse via direct API calls.

admin_proofs_export_csv default limit=2000 but no explicit guard for very large exports — at full scale this could buffer many MB in memory via io.StringIO + iter([buf.getvalue()]). Consider true streaming with yield rows when count > 1000.

Review/action audit fields (admin_review_*) are written but never indexed in MongoDB — admin reports filtering by reviewer or action will scan the full collection. Add a compound index on (admin_review_action, admin_reviewed_at) for crypto_payments / bank_transfer_confirmations / mt5_invest_deposits / partial_withdraw_unlocks.

The 'reviewed' action leaves status untouched (correct per spec) BUT the listing card still displays the unchanged status pill alongside a new reviewed badge — UX could confuse admins into thinking 'reviewed' means 'approved'. Consider a subtle visual indicator like an outline ring on the status pill when admin_review_action is set but status was not modified.

Frontend handleExportCsv reads token directly from localStorage instead of going through safeApiCall — inconsistent with the rest of the page and bypasses the centralized auth/refresh handling in diagnostics.js. Move CSV download through safeApiCall (or add a downloadBlob helper) to keep auth handling consistent.

doAction (frontend) does not show a confirmation modal before destructive Aprobar/Rechazar — a single mis-click immediately changes status and writes audit. Add a quick AlertDialog 'Confirmar aprobación/rechazo' for both actions (current confirmReject flag only gates the rose-ring + toast, not an actual two-step confirmation).
seed_data_creation: Mutated 3 existing crypto_payments via the new endpoint as part of stamping tests: items[0] -> reviewed (status unchanged), items[1] -> rejected, items[2] -> approved. The dev DB now reflects these admin_review_* fields. Notes used: 'TEST_reviewed', 'TEST_fraude', and frontend playwright also wrote 'Test rejection from playwright' on the first card.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_proofs.py (23 tests, ~5s). New testids on AdminProofsPage: proofs-export-csv-btn, proof-action-panel, proof-action-note, proof-action-reviewed-btn, proof-action-approve-btn, proof-action-reject-btn. After this iteration's tests, the 3 crypto_payments in dev DB are stamped with admin_review_action values (reviewed/reject/approve) — if next agent needs clean unreviewed proof, manually clear those fields or insert a new crypto_payment via the test user UI. The reject toast uses Spanish text 'Rechazado'; reviewed toast 'Marcado como revisado'; missing-note toast 'Motivo requerido'. Frontend filename pattern: comprobantes_{type}_{YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM}.csv. Backend filename: proofs_{type}_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.csv.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end on first review. Encountered 1 self-inflicted test bug (used limit=2000 on listing endpoint which caps at 500 → KeyError on missing 'count'); fixed in test by lowering to limit=500 and re-ran cleanly.
